qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: While SFS co-engineers precision components and fasteners with industrial customers, its returns on capital are sub-hurdle following the capital-dilutive acquisition of tool distributor Hoffmann SE, with ROIC of only 8.4% (2024) and 9.3% (2025), failing the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Sub-hurdle ROIC / Moat Proof, REJECT). SFS Group's post-Hoffmann acquisition return on invested capital has compressed to 8.4% (FY2024) and 9.3% (FY2025), failing the strict 12% ROIC moat-proof threshold. SFS lacks sufficient pricing power in wholesale tool distribution and automotive/construction fastening to earn super-normal returns on its CHF 3.3B+ invested capital base.
qualitative.evidence: FY2024 net sales CHF 3,031M, EBIT CHF 350.2M (11.6% margin), reported ROIC 8.4%. FY2025 net sales CHF 3,045M, reported EBIT CHF 324.3M (10.6% margin, 12.2% adjusted), reported ROIC 9.3%. Distribution & Logistics (Hoffmann) represents ~44% of group sales, permanently diluting group capital returns below the 12% hurdle.
